cycle: ADR-075 Phase 3 — GenesisRAG17 edge deployment (SmartGift structured-record profile)
note: The four commits this deployment cycle targets. Each repository's own main may have moved further; these are the versions the ki17 build stage pulls and the pre-deploy gate G-4 checks against the G-2 acceptance record. Never edit a commit here without re-running the acceptance that produced it. Exception recorded 2026-09-16: the genesisblock pin was advanced from 907b0ff4 to 7c9261c4 to pick up the P-2 Linux addon (GenesisBlock PR #177) — the worker source at that commit is unchanged from 907b0ff4 (7c9261c4 is only the merge commit adding the addon binary built from 907b0ff4), so this is not a logic change and does not require a new acceptance run on its own. G-3 (the acceptance run inside these images) is still outstanding regardless.

zuri-ai.note: This repository is the build's own main context, and .dockerignore excludes .git from it, so the build cannot read its own HEAD. Recorded for the G-4 gate and verified by the operator on the host before the build (`git rev-parse HEAD`).

genesisblock.note: P-2 landed (GenesisBlock PR #177, merged as this commit). The Linux napi addon is present at npm/linux-x64-gnu/index.linux-x64-gnu.node, built from and verified against 907b0ff4 (the worker source commit itself; unchanged here). The genesis-worker build target's KI17_GENESISBLOCK_LINUX_ADDON_MISSING assertion should now pass.
